title: STAGE beats: an ink ground with depth, full-width glowing cards, no empty frame
goal:
Krish, 3 Nov 2026: "The graphics in your previous car are honestly fucking embarrassing." The Critic scored Thursday 5 Nov 4/10 against instagram_DeZuQ7-lATg: on STAGE beats (plate none) a typing_bubble or headline draws at the top over a flat ink frame that is 50 to 70% empty (qc composition fill 41 to 70%, the lock needs 80%).

1. STAGE ground (FormatMaster, plate none): replace the flat ink fill with a radial depth gradient built only from tokens (ink_soft at the centre to ink_deep at the edges) under the house grain; never a new colour, never purple-to-blue, no meshes.
2. typing_bubble on a STAGE beat: the card is 960 px wide (60 px margins), centred vertically in the band between the stage header (y 220) and the caption line (y 1267 on graphics-only beats), and grows downward as rows type; type at least 44 px for message text and 34 px for names. Add a soft outer glow in the mint role (blur 40 to 60 px, opacity 0.25 to 0.35) on STAGE and SPLIT cards; entrance rises 40 to 60 px and settles in 4 to 7 frames ease-out (MOTION_STANDARD.md).
3. headline on STAGE with no `at`: centred in the same band, at least 160 px cap height for two short lines.
4. cursor_buddy on a STAGE beat that also uses a card or headline sits below it, clear of the caption line by 60 px, never overlapping text.

Tests: the card box on a STAGE beat with a 2-row typing_bubble spans 960 px and sits between y 220 and 1207 (Claude re-runs the composition fill check after the build; tesseract is not on the building computer); the card's box is 960 wide; the glow uses the mint token; no raw hex added; existing device tests pass.
